proposals.name: GuestLocalRun
proposals.justification: L5 round 4 rule 1 skips EVERY quest-owned script on a guest. About 20 in-scope quests (achievement tracker, casino winnings, perk effects, controller rumble, DLC setup, chargen helpers) only make sense when run on each machine. PerPlayerScene (scene/effects target the originating player) is the closest existing kind, so the patch uses it with scope=local-machine, but its documented meaning does not say "run the quest script on a guest". A dedicated kind would let SuppressPolicy::skipScript consult an allow-list instead of overloading PerPlayerScene.

proposals.name: OwnerCap
proposals.justification: Follower cap per recruiting player (vanilla: 1 humanoid + 1 critter via shared VNPCFollowers vars). Encoded as extra CompanionOwner params in this patch (cap_scope/humanoid/critter/party_total) so no new kind is strictly required; a runtime that wants to reject a recruit must also rewrite the VNPCFollowers condition results per owner (PartyAwareCond over GetQuestVariable).
